about: The world map's pins (#4), decided by hand and checked against Wikidata or the holding museum's own page (see each painting's source). pin: a Wikidata item whose coordinates (P625, in facts.json) are taken, or [lat, lon] where no item fits. place, note and museum are keys; their labels are built by build.js from the Wikidata labels of each key's parts, or taken from terms (a word with no item, or a shorter name than Wikidata's) and from labels (a whole label written by hand). verified: true only when Wikidata's statements on the painting or the museum's page name the place; the painter's work location (Wikidata P937) is noted in source but never counts as proof.
